items.title: Copilot is ‘for entertainment purposes only,’ according to Microsoft’s terms of use
items.summary: AI skeptics aren’t the only ones warning users not to unthinkingly trust models’ outputs — that’s what the AI companies say themselves in their terms of service.

items.title: Can orbital data centers help justify a massive valuation for SpaceX?
items.summary: On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, we debated Elon Musk's vision for data centers in space.

items.title: In Japan, the robot isn’t coming for your job; it’s filling the one nobody wants
items.summary: Driven by labor shortages, Japan is pushing physical AI from pilot projects into real-world deployment.

items.title: Anthropic says Claude Code subscribers will need to pay extra for OpenClaw usage
items.summary: It’s about to become more expensive for Claude Code subscribers to use Anthropic’s coding assistant with OpenClaw and other third-party tools.

items.title: Anthropic is having a moment in the private markets; SpaceX could spoil the party
items.summary: Glen Anderson, president of Rainmaker Securities, says the secondary market for private shares has never been more active — with Anthropic the hottest trade around, OpenAI losing ground, and SpaceX's looming IPO poised to reshape the landscape for everyone.
